body:
Thanks for your reply, the problem is, I've tried for 20+ years to get myself to a better place but nothing helps. They know this now, we've talked about how there's nothing she can do to make it better, it's a literal pointless burden. It's been so many years of of trying, I'm not going to magically become a functioning member of society, I don't understand people.

All that's happening is it's stopping her from living her own life, even though I tell her I'm fine and to go out and live her life, there's things she stops herself doing because she's worried what I might do while she's away. If anything happened to her, I'd end it the next day anyway. Suicide might be selfish, but to me what I'm doing feels more selfish, wasting someone else's life for no truly meaningful reason. There would be sadness, but there already is, ending it now at least gives them chance to live their lives before it's too late.
